name: mailcow
description: mailcow-dockerized: DB auto-detection dumps the MariaDB (mysql-mailcow, root via DBROOT) and the built-in quiesce checkpoints redis-mailcow (BGSAVE). All named volumes are tarred: vmail (the mails - Maildir, file-per-mail, live copy is fine), crypt (mail crypt keys - ESSENTIAL), rspamd, postfix, sogo. Regenerable volumes (clamd DB, fulltext index) are included too - volume-level excludes do not exist; accept the extra size. mailcow.conf + data/conf live in the stack folder. Alternative: mailcows own helper-scripts/backup_and_restore.sh - use ONE of the two as the source of truth. Backups can be large; the 12h service timeout leaves plenty of room.
